fields.summary_ko.0: Compared to Wall Street price target of $1,575 (107% upside) for Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU), author forecasts conservative 2027 year-end target of $1,045 (37% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q4 revenue of $54.2B (379% increase) and data center segment growth exceeding 1000% show strong AI infrastructure demand, though commoditization of memory chips limits pricing power.
fields.summary_ko.2: As pandemic early demand surge followed by supply glut caused price collapse and margin compression, historical memory semiconductor cyclicality threatens growth sustainability.
